title: Infrastructure Operations
description: Renew certificates, patch or move VMs, change DNS: pre-check, four-eyes approval, simulated execution and audit evidence. n8n orchestrates, Ansible runs through AWX. Joule can hand a change to n8n in check mode.
insights: The Cloud Connector certificate of Nordlicht Logistik has expired; the server certificate of Beispiel Pharma expires in 5 days.
Every change is checked against the inventory, freeze periods, backup age and dependencies before it can be created.
Production needs two approvals from different roles; the requester cannot approve their own change.
Fictional sample data and simulated execution. “Submit to n8n” sends a check-mode request only, once a webhook is configured.
prompt: Bundled example: Infrastructure Operations (static, data and model embedded by npm run sync:infra-ops).
